name: splunk-bots-${localEnv:BOTS_SERVICE:bots1}
initializeCommand: case '${localEnv:BOTS_SERVICE:bots1}' in bots1|bots2|bots3) ;; *) printf '%s\n' 'BOTS_SERVICE must be bots1, bots2, or bots3.' >&2; exit 64;; esac
postStartCommand: sudo install -d -m 0755 -o vscode -g vscode /home/vscode/.ollama /home/vscode/.ollama/models && NODE=$(ls /vscode/vscode-server/bin/linux-*/*/node 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true) && [ -n "$NODE" ] && sudo ln -sf "$NODE" /usr/local/bin/node
